dimensions.assessment: Affects federal telecommunications researchers, commercial entities using spectrum, and workers in confined spaces such as underground mines or high-rise buildings.
dimensions.evidence: support the development of emergency communication and tracking technologies for use in locating trapped individuals in confined spaces

dimensions.assessment: Provides statutory authority for an existing test center and directs new assessments and reports on emergency communication technologies and spectrum sharing.
dimensions.evidence: The Assistant Secretary, acting through the head of ITS, shall establish an initiative to support the development of emergency communication and tracking technologies

dimensions.assessment: The source authorizes entering into agreements and conducting assessments, but does not provide specific appropriation or spending amounts.
Establishes statutory provisions for the Institute for Telecommunication Sciences and a new emergency communication and tracking initiative with reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: To codify the Institute for Telecommunication Sciences and to direct the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Communications and Information to establish an initiative

dimensions.assessment: Permanent codification of the test center, paired with a one-time reporting requirement within 18 months.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 18 months after the date of the enactment of this section, the Assistant Secretary shall submit to Congress... a report

missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budgetary authorizations for the new initiative.
importance_detail.rationale: Codifies the Institute for Telecommunication Sciences within the NTIA and establishes an initiative to support emergency communication and tracking technologies for confined spaces.
